title: Pat Freiermuth: Aaron Rodgers said what he said, I'm focused on Denver

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Pat Freiermuth: Aaron Rodgers said what he said, I'm focused on Denver
sources.description: While Aaron Rodgers was going scorched earth on the Steelers and head coach Mike McCarthy during Wednesday's appearance on The Pat McAfee Show, he said that tight end Pat Freiermuth informed him of the team's decision to bench him on Tuesday night.
